selected_experts.reason: To verify if the wheel style (wire/spoke/mag) is correctly identified as a valid automotive component and not a hallucinated object.
To ensure the wheel sits correctly within the fender arch and does not exhibit 'floating' or depth bleeding into the car body.
To check for clean boundaries between the rubber tire and metal rim, ensuring no melting or fusion artifacts exist at the contact point.
To assess the realism of reflections on the chrome and paint, which are common failure points in AI-generated car images.

Physical plausibility of the tire deformation against the ground (contact patch)

Boundary sharpness between the car body and the background
